name: Zenra Toukou Shuukan: Chijoku no Sanshuukan
original_name: 全裸登校週間　恥辱の三週間
source: A idol suddenly quits her job to finish high school and follow her dream of becoming a doctor. However, the most prestigious that she attends has a strange rule: each year there's a week where all students must attend naked. As an idol, Saki Haruka had been exempted from this practice to protect her reputation. However, with her job ending now, Haruka has to repay all her "debts" - three weeks of attending school completely naked! She will have to attend class, run a marathon or catch the train - all naked! As the headmaster and her friends dislike her due to the previous special status, Haruka would live through the hardest time in her life, filled with humiliation
translation: 一位偶像突然辞去了工作，完成高中学业，追随她成为一名医生的梦想。然而，她就读的最负盛名的学校有一个奇怪的规定：每年有一个星期，所有学生必须裸体参加。作为偶像，咲遥为了保护自己的名誉而被免除了这种做法。然而，随着她的工作结束，遥必须偿还她所有的“债务”——三周全裸上学！她必须赤身裸体去上课、跑马拉松或赶火车！由于之前的特殊身份，校长和她的朋友们都不喜欢她，遥因此度过了她一生中最艰难的时期，充满了屈辱。
